$comment: Raw numeric extraction of every named legendary mod from the Patch 70 client data. Numbers only (no game text). properties = OMOD property rows (value is the property's own number; curve = the curve table that scales it, evaluated by the game at the given x); effects = ENCH/MGEF rows (magnitude, duration, curve). Curve x is the game's own input (health fraction, stacks, pieces worn, level...). No entry here changes a builder number by itself: legendary-effect-model.json rows cite these.

source.method: xEdit 4.1.5f record dump (OMOD, ENCH and the linked MGEF/CURV records) + direct BA2 read of the curve JSONs; read-only local copy of the game files

calibration.expected: up to +130% damage at 5% health, linear to 0 at full health

unresolved.note: two sprint curves exist in the data (armor_cavalier x0.9 per piece; armor_lessdamagesprinting x0.95 per step) and the perk does not say which applies; needs an in-game reading

unresolved.effect: Armor slayer mods (Assassin's, Hunter's, ... armor side)
unresolved.note: the -15% per piece curve (CT_Legendary_Armor_LessDMG*) is matched to the mod by the actor-value name (LGND_DmgFrom<X>); the perk record does not name the curve
